summary.result: Although there has been little change in green areas of Tsukuba-si for 30 years, the dense vegetation area and connectivity was found to have improved in the core area.
summary.background: Through a review of previous research on both aspects of people’s use and ecosystems, three analysis items were set: “Green Connectivity,” “Accessibility of Urban Parks”, and “Quality of Urban Parks”.
summary.method: As a result, the Multifunctional Administrative City has relatively high accessibility to urban parks, but the connectivity and quality of green areas were found to be low.
